Introduction
This document details the test steps I2, which are
 performed on the fault recorder type 16132 manufacturer Hathaway, on a monthly
 basis M1.
Safety Precautions
Work order should be issued,
The DFR should be in service,
Appropriate personnel protective equipment must be used.
Tools and Equipment
Normal multimeter or digital Multimeter,
Complete set of screwdrivers.
Blower, musk.
Work to be Carried Out
Clean both inside / outside of the fault recorder panel from
 dust using the blower.
Checking the Operation Lamps
Check the lamps (6, 7, 8) should be OFF.
Check the alarm lamps no. (1, 2, 3) should be OFF.
Checking the Printer & DC/DC Converter
Check the lamps no. (1, 2, 4) should be ON, and lamp no. 3
 OFF
Check visually the DC / DC converter
